title: Cadeia de suprimentos autônoma: benefícios e desafios
summary: Entenda o que é uma cadeia de suprimentos autônoma, os principais benefícios, quais os desafios e as melhores práticas para superar cada um!
body_text: A cadeia de suprimentos autônoma consiste na construção de um ecossistema, com diferentes tecnologias integradas, que automatizam, robotizam e digitalizam todas as atividades relacionadas ao fluxo de abastecimento de uma empresa, como Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Internet das Coisas (IoT). Imagine uma rede varejista que conte com sensores no estoque que registram automaticamente as vendas das mercadorias. Ao chegar a um determinado número de unidades estocadas, o sistema emite automaticamente um pedido de compra ao fornecedor e, assim, evita rupturas. Esse é apenas um dos benefícios da automação da cadeia de suprimentos, que também ajuda a reduzir custos operacionais, promover a resiliência na rede de abastecimento e a aumentar a satisfação dos clientes. Quer vantagens assim na sua empresa? Então, siga a leitura e confira o que é uma cadeia de suprimentos autônoma, o impacto da tecnologia na logística e demais processos relacionais e quais soluções usar. O que é cadeia de suprimentos autônoma? A cadeia de suprimentos autônoma é um modelo de gerenciamento pautado na digitalização e robotização das atividades de abastecimento. O conceito abrange desde a criação de produtos até a entrega ao cliente final, e passa por etapas como aquisição de matérias-primas e gestão de estoque. O objetivo é automatizar os processos de supply chain de ponta a ponta e eliminar a intervenção humana a fim de aumentar a eficiência, reduzir o tempo de execução e diminuir os erros. Existem diferentes tipos de automação da cadeia de suprimentos que ajudam a chegar a resultados assim: preditiva : utiliza análise avançada de dados e algoritmos para prever eventos e auxiliar os gestores e seus times a anteciparem ações necessárias para garantir o fluxo de abastecimento; inteligente : integra diferentes tecnologias, como Inteligência Artificial e Internet das Coisas para decisões autônomas em tempo real; escalável : tem como base de funcionamento sistemas de automação que se expandem à medida que o volume de operações da supply chain aumenta; integrada : conecta diversos elos da cadeia de abastecimento por meio de, por exemplo, tecnologia de logística, gestão de fornecedores e gerenciamento de estoque, a fim de criar fluxos contínuos. Dica de leitura: “ Por que usar soluções integradas na cadeia de suprimentos? ” Quais os benefícios da automação da cadeia de suprimentos? Estes são os principais benefícios da automação da cadeia de suprimentos: redução de custos operacionais; melhora da satisfação do cliente final; eliminação de erros humanos; aprimoramento da eficiência operacional; agilidade às mudanças do mercado; aumento do poder competitivo da companhia; planejamentos e previsibilidade de estoque mais precisos; ganho de visibilidade, controle e rastreamento de mercadorias; fomento à sustentabilidade e responsabilidade social; promoção da resiliência empresarial . Ainda sobre os benefícios da automação nesta área, segundo a McKinsey & Company , o planejamento autônomo da cadeia de suprimentos — um dos processos do fluxo de abastecimento — pode aumentar a receita de uma empresa em até 4%, reduzir a necessidade de estoque de até 20% e diminuir os custos em até 10% . Logo, não há dúvidas de como a automação da cadeia de suprimentos pode ajudar a sua empresa a crescer. Contudo, para chegar a bons resultados, é necessário superar alguns obstáculos. A exemplo dos que listamos no próximo tópico. Quais são e como enfrentar os desafios da cadeia de suprimentos autônoma? Por mais que os pontos positivos sejam significativos, para obtê-los é preciso enfrentar desafios como: altos custos iniciais : a construção de uma infraestrutura digital que inclua, por exemplo, tecnologia de logística baseada em blockchain ou robótica e recursos de IA e IoT, pode onerar o caixa da empresa, principalmente as de pequeno e médio porte; resistência organizacional e cultural: os profissionais da área de compras e procurement podem se sentir ameaçados e considerar que a tecnologia os substituirá; segurança de dados : assegurar a proteção das informações transacionadas, evitar ataques cibernéticos e garantir a compliance, como o atendimento da LGPD ; formação de parcerias estratégicas: o que pode levar à dependência de fornecedores que adotam tecnologias para automatizar os processos em detrimento aos que não trabalham dessa maneira. Como resolvê-los? Estas são algumas práticas: custos elevados : amenize com a implementação gradual das tecnologias, obtenção de linhas de crédito e incentivos fiscais; oposição dos funcionários e/ou gestores : apresentação de dados e estudos que comprovam a eficácia de uma cadeia de suprimentos autônoma, treinamento e comunicação transparente; proteção a ciberataques : investimento em camadas de proteção com criptografia e autenticação em dois fatores, definição de política de acesso controlado e auditorias regulares; evitar a dependência de fornecedores : diversificação de parceiros de abastecimento, por meio de um processo de homologação que busque empresas fornecedoras que utilizam tecnologias avançadas. Como a tecnologia impulsiona a automação da cadeia de suprimentos? Não há como construir uma cadeia de suprimentos autônoma sem usar a tecnologia, concorda? Os sistemas, softwares e ferramentas tecnológicas são os pilares do conceito e a chave para transformar tarefas manuais e automáticas. Para construir uma supply chain automatizada na sua empresa, você deve considerar o uso de tecnologias como: Internet das Coisas (IoT) : ajuda a, por exemplo, rastrear o estoque e localizar rapidamente mercadorias nos armazéns, o que melhora a identificação de necessidade de compras; Inteligência Artificial (IA) : automatiza inúmeras atividades como análise automática de dados, documentos e aprovação de fornecedores; machine learning : ideal para identificar padrões necessários para automatizar uma determinada tarefa ou fluxo; blockchain : aumenta a transparência dos processos, a segurança de dados e a rastreabilidade; robótica e automação física : por meio de recursos como o RPA (Robotic Process Automation) que têm o potencial para, por exemplo, organizar estoques, processar pedidos de compras, enviar notificações e cobrar fornecedores; big data e analytics : ferramentas que identificam tendências de mercado, comportamento dos consumidores e que analisam grandes volumes de dados, essenciais para embasar decisões; computação em nuvem : facilita o armazenamento de dados, informações, documentos e arquivos e a colaboração entre os times; ERPs integrados : os sistemas de planejamento de recursos empresariais unificam os departamentos da empresa, entregam uma visão geral das atividades e resultados e, assim, otimizam as gestões. title: Signal-Based Selling: The New Outbound Playbook

Instead of spraying outreach across your entire addressable market, you prioritize accounts showing active buying signals. title: Compras colaborativas: por que adotar? 7 vantagens!
summary: Entenda o que são compras colaborativas, as vantagens para a sua empresa e o que é preciso para adotar esse modelo de aquisição no seu negócio!
body_text: As compras colaborativas são uma estratégia de aquisição de insumos, matérias-primas ou contratação de serviços na qual duas ou mais empresas se unem para conseguir condições melhores junto aos fornecedores, a exemplo de volumes maiores, redução do preço ou condições de pagamento mais favoráveis. Trata-se de uma abordagem interessante para companhias com necessidades de abastecimento similares, porém, que têm pouco poder de negociação com as empresas fornecedoras. Assim, ao juntar as requisições, é possível obter economia de escala e aumentar a eficiência nas aquisições. Como é possível? Siga a leitura e entenda, em detalhes, o que é um modelo de compras colaborativas, como funciona, as vantagens e como implementar no seu negócio. O que são compras colaborativas? As compras colaborativas são uma forma de aquisição de produtos e/ou serviços na qual empresas com necessidades de abastecimento semelhantes se unem para elevar o potencial de negociação com os fornecedores. É uma ótima estratégia principalmente para negócios de pequeno porte que precisam otimizar a cadeia de suprimentos. Diversos setores podem adotar um modelo de compras colaborativas, como educação, saúde, agricultura e varejo. Nesse contexto, é fundamental alinhar necessidades semelhantes de matérias-primas, insumos e serviços, estabelecendo parâmetros que garantam eficiência nas aquisições e promovam a redução de custos para todos os parceiros envolvidos. Sugestão de leitura: “ Gestão de pedidos de compras: quais as 5 melhores práticas? ” 7 vantagens das compras colaborativas para as empresas Adotar um modelo de compras colaborativas é interessante porque gera para o seu negócio vantagens como: melhor aproveitamento dos recursos financeiros, com potencial de diminuir gastos com abastecimento; economia de escala, que é a redução do custo médio de produção à medida que a quantidade produzida aumenta; mais poder de negociação, principalmente pela aquisição de volumes maiores de insumos; acesso a empresas fornecedoras de grande porte, mais inovadoras, o que reflete no potencial competitivo da sua companhia; melhoria da qualidade dos insumos e, consequentemente, das soluções que a sua companhia vende aos clientes finais; otimização da gestão de estoque e redução do risco de ruptura; construção de parcerias estratégicas com os fornecedores. Entenda a importância do último benefício no artigo: “ Relacionamento estratégico com fornecedores: como construir um sólido? ” Como funcionam as compras colaborativas? Há mais de um modelo de compras colaborativas. É possível, por exemplo, fechar acordos somente entre duas empresas ou criar consórcios que incluam diversas companhias. Todavia, independentemente da quantidade de negócios envolvidos, é crucial considerar e ponderar sobre pontos, como: identificação de necessidades de abastecimento em comum; fluxo logístico, prazos e ritmo de distribuição; definição de padrões de qualidade; conformidade com leis gerais e específicas do ramo de atuação das empresas compradoras; escolha de representantes para negociar diretamente com os fornecedores; estabelecimento de cláusulas contratuais entre as companhias e entre os negócios e os fornecedores; determinação de parâmetros de monitoramento de cumprimento de contrato e de avaliação de desempenho dos fornecedores . Pense que, ao contrário de fazer compras individuais para a sua empresa, é preciso alinhar os seus interesses aos de outra companhia, o que inclui questões como prazos de entrega e valores. Portanto, antes de adotar um modelo de compras colaborativas por conta das vantagens, avalie os prós e os contras, o impacto no seu fluxo de abastecimento, na rotina de produção e o custo-benefício que a estratégia pode gerar. Desafios e cuidados na implementação das compras colaborativas Nessa linha de raciocínio, o alinhamento de necessidade de abastecimento é um dos principais desafios dessa forma de aquisição. Estes são outros bastante comuns: problemas na comunicação e na troca de informações; dificuldade de coordenação do fluxo logístico; estabelecimento de níveis de qualidade; proteção de dados; gerenciamento de riscos; garantia de compliance em todas as etapas; distribuição de responsabilidades. Uma das melhores estratégias para resolver conflitos assim é por meio de conversas transparentes e sinceras entre os representantes das empresas compradoras. É fundamental que cada profissional traga para a discussão um planejamento de compras devidamente elaborado e aprovado, com critérios claros sobre as regras, necessidades, políticas e valores da companhia, a fim de comparar com os demais e, juntos, chegarem a um consenso favorável a todos. Em seguida, é essencial registrar os pontos acordados em um contrato para evitar desentendimentos e prejuízos futuros. Este artigo pode ajudar você: “ Gestão de contratos: como fazer corretamente? 5 dicas! ” Como formar parcerias estratégicas com fornecedores? Para formar parcerias estratégicas com fornecedores, é essencial escolher e contratar aqueles que comprovadamente entregam o que precisam as empresas envolvidas nas compras colaborativas. title: Shimmer Launches 2.0: AI Tools to Amplify Human-Centered ADHD Coaching
summary: We’re excited to introduce Shimmer 2.0, a breakthrough AI-powered coaching experience co-created with our ADHD community—designed to amplify insights, accountability, and real progress during & between every session.
body_text: 💡 Tl;dr: Shimmer is an ADHD coaching platform designed to help neurodivergent adults reach their full potential. We’re excited to introduce Shimmer 2.0, leveraging AI tools to make your coaching experience even more effective, simpler, and action-oriented than before. Instead, it amplifies the human connection between you and your coach, ensuring every breakthrough is captured and every insight drives real change. We launched on Product Hunt today! Check out our launch, and support us by upvoting by 11:59pm PT today (Thursday Jan 23). Background: Shimmer’s ADHD Coaching System Shimmer is the leading ADHD Coaching Platform, born from our co-founder & CEO, Christal’s ADHD diagnosis in 2022. Since then, we’ve refined our experience and methodology alongside experts at NYU and Mount Sinai and delivered over 45,000 sessions. At Shimmer, we’ve created a coaching cycle that supports you every step of the way, blending personalized guidance, real-time feedback, and tangible progress tracking. Here’s how it works: Weekly 30-Minute Coaching Sessions: Meet one-on-one with an ADHD-specialized coach who helps you define a clear North Star - your personal vision statement - and break it down into weekly goals. In-App Tracking & Reflection: Log daily actions, note what went well (and what didn’t), and reflect on lessons learned—all in one place. Real-Time Coach Support: Stay connected with your coach between sessions through chat, getting instant accountability and motivation when you need it. Grow & Evolve: Each week builds on the last—together, you’ll refine strategies, celebrate wins, and form lasting habits that move you closer to your ultimate goals . Why Shimmer 2.0? Lessons from 45,000+ Coaching Sessions At Shimmer, we’ve run over 45,000 coaching sessions with ADHDers. Along the way, we discovered three big challenges they face in the coaching journey: Remembering what was discussed in each session —the “aha” moments often slip through the cracks. Recalling and spotting themes across multiple sessions —it’s tough to see the bigger picture when everything feels fragmented. Making sense of day-to-day experiences between sessions —a coach can’t be with you 24/7, so staying on track can be difficult. Our Solution: A “Second Brain” That Bridges Every Gap That’s where Shimmer 2.0 comes in. We’ve built an AI-powered system to capture, organize, and make sense of all of your coaching moments—both in-session and throughout the week. Think of it as your “second brain,” offering: Instant recall of session insights when you need them most. Pattern detection so you can see recurring themes and long-term progress. Daily support that helps turn your coach’s guidance into consistent action, even when they’re not physically by your side. By integrating AI at every step of your coaching journey, Shimmer 2.0 shortens the path from insight to action —making it easier to stay accountable, keep building on your wins, and finally connect the dots between each breakthrough. Our Philosophy: Safe, Human-Centered AI Safety First & Ethical by Design At Shimmer, we’re laser-focused on making sure AI serves you safely, ethically, and securely. The insights generated by AI remain yours to export, revisit, or delete at any time. To ensure fairness and inclusivity, we actively work to identify and eliminate biases in our AI systems, with ongoing evaluations and updates. AI Enhances , Not Replaces There’s a reason our amazing coaches are at the heart of the Shimmer experience: **ADHD coaching is deeply personal**, rooted in empathy, understanding, and a trusting coach-client relationship. AI helps by automating note-taking, spotting trends, and offering reflection prompts. But it doesn’t replace the human compassion and expertise that is critical for effective ADHD support. We designed Shimmer 2.0 to work alongside expert coaches because compassion can’t be automated. The AI is just there to capture the magic of each session and support you in-between, acting like a second brain.”— Chris Wang, Co-founder & CEO of Shimmer Built with User Feedback at its Core Our AI isn’t static—it evolves with you. We regularly incorporate feedback from members and coaches to improve its accuracy, relevance, and helpfulness. Your experiences shape how we innovate, ensuring that our tools stay aligned with your needs. What’s New in Shimmer 2.0 AI-Powered Session Summaries (powered by Daily and Deepgram ) Recalling key takeaways from a coaching session can be a struggle, especially when you’re juggling multiple tasks or jumping straight into your next meeting. Shimmer 2.0’s AI automatically recaps each session’s main points and action items, so you can easily revisit breakthroughs without piecing together scattered notes. Action Insights & Progress Tracking Even the best intentions can fall off your radar when life gets busy, leaving you scrambling right before a session. Our new Action Insights & Progress Tracking visually map out your weekly actions, highlight patterns, and keep you accountable—ensuring you know exactly what’s working and where to focus next. AI History & Smart Search Digging through old notes or relying on memory alone often leads to missed details and repeated mistakes. With AI History & Smart Search, you can instantly look up specific topics from past sessions and spot recurring themes at a glance, making every lesson and strategy easier to recall and apply. The Value: How Shimmer 2.0 Improves Your Coaching Journey Shimmer 2.0 weaves AI into your everyday coaching experience, turning scattered notes and fleeting insights into a well-structured path toward your goals. By eliminating the gaps in memory and ensuring consistent follow-through, it helps you and your coach focus on what really matters: breakthroughs and lasting change . Shimmer 2.0 helps you: Stay in the Moment ‍ By automating note-taking, you’re free to fully engage in each coaching conversation. No more frantic scribbling when you should be absorbing insights. Recall Made Easy ‍ ADHD coaching isn’t a one-time fix; it’s an evolving process across multiple sessions. Shimmer 2.0 keeps an organized record throughout your coaching journey, ensuring no valuable “aha” moment gets lost in the shuffle. More Frequent, Deeper A-ha Moments ‍ With AI Smart Search, you’ll quickly see how and why you overcame past hurdles. This creates a shortcut to replicating what worked and troubleshooting what didn’t. Measure Progress & Celebrate Wins ‍ Real growth becomes undeniable when you have tangible evidence. Whether it’s noticing fewer “self-doubt” moments or celebrating consistent wins, these metrics fuel motivation and self-confidence. Elevated Coach Support ‍ Coaches can easily spot themes, patterns, and recurring challenges, which means more targeted support for you. When you both arrive at sessions on the same page, you can tackle the most pressing issues head-on. Real-Life Use Cases Habit Consistency “I used to fall off my workout plan after a week or two. That way, I’m ready to talk about what worked, what didn’t, and where I’m stuck—sessions are short so this way I get to make the most of it.” —Shimmer member What’s Next for Shimmer? As we continue to expand Shimmer, we depend on the community’s feedback to refine our features and ensure that every update truly meets and exceeds needs. Alongside these enhancements, we’re also focused on making Shimmer accessible to a wider audience by reaching more regions and offering support to anyone seeking ADHD coaching. Ultimately, our goal is to ensure everyone, regardless of location or circumstance, has the resources and guidance they deserve to reach their full potential, their way. title: AI-First Customer Service: The Future of Customer Support with AI Agents
summary: Learn how AI first customer service improves response times, and enhances customer experiences while working alongside human agents.
body_text: Customer expectations have changed, no doubt. People want instant, personalized, and effortless support without long wait times or scripted chatbot responses. To keep up, businesses are moving from AI-assisted to AI-first customer service. Why make this shift? The answer is efficiency and scale. AI-first customer service reduces response times, cuts support costs, and delivers proactive assistance. For example, AI agents can detect customer frustration, suggest solutions before they are needed, and analyze interactions to improve future experiences. Businesses using AI-first models like chatbots have reported a 30% drop in support costs while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Are you still relying on AI as just an assistant? It might be time to rethink your strategy. Let’s explore how AI-first customer service can transform the way you support your customers. What is AI-first customer service? AI-first customer service is AI taking the lead in handling customer support rather than just assisting human agents. For example, if you message a company asking, “Where’s my order?” an AI agent can track it and give you an update in seconds, instead of waiting for a human agent. AI-first models can also detect frustration, adapt to customer needs, and improve with every interaction. Human agents still play a role, but AI handles most routine tasks, freeing up humans for more complex support issues. body_text: This article is from The National Law Review: https://lnkd.in/e_qep9g4 In a significant shift for unionized workplaces, the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) has made it much more difficult for employers to unilaterally implement changes to working conditions—even when management rights clauses exist in collective bargaining agreements. The decision, issued on December 10, 2024 , in Endurance Environmental Solutions, LLC (Case No. 09–CA–273873) , overturns a 2019 Trump-era ruling and reinstates a stricter legal standard that has serious implications for how employers manage union-represented employees. The Case: Surveillance Cameras Trigger a Legal Dispute The case involved an employer’s decision to install cameras inside company trucks to monitor employee conduct. The union objected, stating it was not notified and did not have an opportunity to bargain over the decision. The employer, relying on a management rights clause in the collective bargaining agreement, believed it had the authority to act unilaterally. However, the NLRB disagreed. The Ruling: No More “Contract Coverage” Shortcut In its ruling, the Board’s Democratic majority explicitly overruled the 2019 decision in MV Transportation, Inc. , which had adopted a more employer-friendly “contract coverage” standard . Under that standard, employers were allowed to make unilateral changes if their actions were arguably covered by a management rights clause in the collective bargaining agreement. The Board has now reinstated the “clear and unmistakable waiver” standard, which had governed NLRB decisions for over 70 years before MV Transportation . Under this stricter standard, an employer cannot rely on general contract language . Instead, the union must have explicitly and unmistakably waived its right to bargain over the specific subject at issue. If there is any ambiguity, the employer must notify the union and offer to bargain before making changes. Why This Matters: Surveillance = Mandatory Bargaining The Board also reaffirmed that the use of surveillance, including cameras, is a “mandatory subject of bargaining” —especially when surveillance could potentially lead to employee discipline. This means that, absent a clear waiver from the union, employers must engage in bargaining before implementing any surveillance measures . In this case, because the employer failed to provide the union notice and denied a bargaining request, the Board found a violation of the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) . What Employers Should Do Now Unionized employers must take this ruling seriously. The return to the “clear and unmistakable waiver” standard significantly narrows the scope of unilateral action under management rights clauses. To avoid unfair labor practice charges, employers should: Review management rights clauses in collective bargaining agreements for specificity. Avoid making unilateral changes to mandatory subjects of bargaining (e.g., wages, hours, surveillance, working conditions) without prior notice to the union. Document all union communications relating to workplace changes. Train supervisors and HR leaders on the reinstated bargaining obligations. Consult legal counsel before rolling out workplace policies or changes that could affect union-represented employees. Final Thoughts The NLRB’s decision in Endurance Environmental Solutions is a game-changer for how unionized employers must approach workplace management. With the bar now raised, even long-standing contract language may no longer shield employers from bargaining obligations. Until and unless a union clearly and unmistakably waives its rights, employers must be prepared to negotiate or face legal consequences .

title: Women in Wine: Meet Winegrower Sadie Drury
summary: How did you get started in the wine industry? In 2005, I took a job bartending at a local hotspot and started growing an interest in wine. I also met many great individuals working in the wine industry who quickly became my friends. I went on a date with someone who took me to a […]
body_text: How did you get started in the wine industry? In 2005, I took a job bartending at a local hotspot and started growing an interest in wine. I also met many great individuals working in the wine industry who quickly became my friends. I went on a date with someone who took me to a vineyard, and I immediately fell in love with the idea of growing grapes. The guy didn’t last, but my desire to grow grapes was set. I have always loved working in agriculture and being outdoors. I knew winegrowing was a way to combine all the things I loved at that time. I enrolled in the Enology and Viticulture program at Walla Walla Community College in 2007 and the rest is history. How did you end up managing SeVein Vineyards? I worked on a vineyard in the Red Mountain AVA for five vintages, from 2008 to 2012. During that time, I drove about 1.5 hours each way to work. By 2012, I was married and pregnant and looking for work closer to my home in Walla Walla. The job for Assistant Viticulturist at North Slope Management was posted on winejobs.com the day our first daughter was born. I applied and interviewed for that position when she was just a few weeks old and started when she was only 2 months old. I was promoted to Vineyard Manager and Viticulturist less than a year later. Pambrun Vineyard is located on the Oregon side of the Walla Walla Valley AVA. What is unique about Oregon wines? There are several things I love about Oregon wines. The state as a whole is incredibly diverse. There isn’t a varietal that can’t grow well somewhere in Oregon, meaning there’s a wine that pairs with every meal and every season. I also love that Oregon has been a leader in sustainability long before other states and regions, which is a testament to the quality and the care taken in making Oregon wines. Do you have a favorite Pambrun wine? I love all the Pambrun wines but I am always a sucker for the Merlot. Pambrun is committed to crafting elegant, terroir-driven wines from high-elevation hillside plantings in SeVein. What does your day-to-day work look like? I usually start my mornings with my crew, making sure all the tractors and people are doing the work we need to get done that day. After that, I try to drive around all the blocks that we farm – over 100 – and walk into some of the blocks and check the vines for pests, diseases and irrigation needs. I try to physically walk through all the blocks at least once a week, but I drive around them all every day. I have to spend some time in the office making sure the bills and people are paid and all necessary supplies are ordered. I’ll write down any work, irrigation and tractor orders needed for the next day. What was your reaction to being featured in the Wine Country Women book? It was such a surprise to be asked to be included in the book, and it was a true honor to be included alongside so many amazing and successful peers. What does it mean to you to be a woman in wine? First and foremost, I always wanted to be great at my job. I didn’t set out to be seen as a great woman winegrower. I just wanted to be a great winegrower. I believe I’ve succeeded at that. When I decided to grow grapes 18 years ago, I didn’t know I would be only one of a handful of women vineyard managers. I didn’t know I would be paving the way for others. Now that I’ve been successful in my job and have shown other women it can be done, being a woman in wine means much more than I anticipated. I feel like I now have an obligation to mentor, support, hire and include other women in all the work I do. It’s been an amazing journey to watch the network of women in wine grow the way it has. Sadie Drury hopes to inspire other women to make their own impact in the wine industry. What do you do in your free time? I hang out with my family and drive my kids to their sports during my free time. If I can sneak away from my kids, I try to go out and ride my horse, Sam, also seen in “Wine Country Women of Willamette Valley & Walla Walla.”
